ui_access: public read-only (no auth)  -- 'no blocker for UI access'

allow_read_only.edge_rule: location ~* \.(js|css|map|...)$ { limit_except GET HEAD { deny all; } }

deny_at_edge.note: Execution + dynamic API surfaces are blocked here and are NOT proxied across WireGuard to the backend.

backend_hardening_recommendation.vps_to_wg_peer: allow UDP 51820 from VPS; block 51820 from all other sources
backend_hardening_recommendation.ufw: ufw default deny incoming; ufw allow from <wg interface peer IP> to 10.10.0.4 port 8080

apply: Not applied from this environment. Copy the .conf to /etc/nginx/sites-available/, symlink to sites-enabled, ensure TLS certs exist (certbot -d knowledge.letterblack.co.ae), then: nginx -t && systemctl reload nginx
